name: USW-Industrial
title: Switch Industrial
summary: Hardened fanless 10-port 1GbE L2 switch, 8 PoE++ ports, 430 W, -40 to 60 C; discontinued.

extra.port_note: spec lists 1 GbE RJ45=10 (8 PoE++); no SFP listed
extra.limited_l2: fewer L2 features (no LACP/802.1X/IGMP listed), 256 VLANs

gotchas: Legacy, not in store — the USW-Industrial-DIN-2.5G-8-PoE is the coming replacement (adds 2.5GbE + SFP+).
1GbE only with no SFP uplink listed — bottleneck for 8 PoE++ devices.
Stripped L2 feature set (no LACP/802.1X listed, 256 VLANs) vs. other UniFi switches.
No IP rating listed despite 'industrial' — still needs an enclosure outdoors.
best_for: hot/cold plant rooms powering 60 W PTZ/APs
